name: cli-init-minimal-seed
body: Minimal init seed: `eypres init` writes, in addition to the deck (`eypres.yaml`, `slides/`, empty `assets/`), a minimal `templates/` directory: `library.yaml`, ONE slide template `hello` (a required `title` text field, optional body; a plain layout) with a validating `example.md`, and ONE theme `default` whose `theme.css` uses only system fonts and neutral colours — no fonts, no logos, no media, no EY branding. The deck has one slide `slides/1-hello.md` using `hello`, and `eypres.yaml` has a title and no/`default` theme. The seed is the only template content carried by the binary; it is embedded in internal/scaffold, not internal/assets. AC: immediately after init, `eypres start` validates templates and deck cleanly and serves the single "hello world" slide; grep of the seed finds no "EY"/EY font or logo reference.
